products.title: SUPREMACY INCENSE
products.body_html:
This fragrance takes you on a refreshing hike deep in the woodlands, where the golden leaves of autumn pass glide and circle around, a mild freshness of citrus and spice awakening the senses, arriving victorious at the mountain peak where a leathery earthiness of towering trees below fill the air.

PERFUME NOTES

Top Notes: Bergamot, Oregano and Pepper
Middle Notes: Amber, Labdanum and Opoponax
Base Notes: Leather, Sandalwood, Patchouli and Oud

products.title: SUPREMACY GALA - LUXURY COLLECTION
products.body_html:
A captivating fragrance for the contemporary woman. This exquisite scent blends the freshness of pear blossom and mandarin orange with the lushness of gardenia and frangipani, culminating in a rich base of vanilla, caramel, and patchouli. Perfect for both day and night, this perfume is your gateway to a world of sophisticated charm.

PERFUME NOTES

Top Notes:Â Pear Blossom, Red Berries and Mandarin Orange
Middle Notes: Gardenia, Frangipani and Honeysuckle
Base Notes: Vanilla, Brown Sugar, Caramel, Praline and Patchouli

products.title: SUPREMACY IN OUD 100 ML
products.body_html:
Step into the realm of opulence and indulgence with Supremacy in Oud, a rich and extraordinary blend with precious oud as the central muse. The perfume pays homage to the renowned Middle Eastern traditions of elegant intoxicating fragrant trail with a heady lingering aura; a scent signature that announces a wearer much before the arrival.

PERFUME NOTES

Top Notes: Saffron, Lavender and Nutmeg
Middle Notes: Agarwood and Sweet
Base Notes: Musk and Patchouli

products.title: 9 AM - Pour Femme
products.body_html:
A captivating and sophisticated fragrance for the modern and independent woman. Opening with a burst of vibrant and fresh top notes, this fragrance immediately energizes the senses, creating a feeling of optimism and vitality. As the scent evolves, the fruity middle notes add a touch of femininity and grace. The base notes provide a warm and sensual foundation, leaving a lingering trail of sophistication and allure. With its harmonious blend of accords, this scent is the perfect accessory for any occasion, enhancing the wearer's natural charm and leaving a memorable impression.

PERFUME NOTES

Top Notes: Mandarin, Bergamot and Grapefruit
Middle Notes: Black Currant and Raspberry
Base Notes: Musk, Orange and Amber

products.title: AFNAN 9AM FEMME Perfume SPRAY 250 ML
products.body_html: Afnan 9am is a refreshing and vibrant fragrance for women, with top notes of mandarin, bergamot, and grapefruit that awaken the senses. The heart reveals a delightful blend of black currant and raspberry, while the base notes of musk, orange, and amber provide a warm, inviting finish. Perfect for those who love a bright, fruity fragrance with a touch of elegance.
